_doc: syncA 2026-09-29/30: t.f remains an effect HIT placement, never an onset measurement. Current pre-3600 observations and fail-closed whole-film audit registry follow under audit. No >=3600 effect timing is changed; asound owns that region. Numeric mix onsets are masking proxies, not listening judgments. Unknowns are null and block certification. Historical prose is retained under historical_previous_record only; it is not current evidence.

A.blow.heard: Current sound_A aggregate onset is not cue-isolated; adjacent control fails 10 dB separation.
A.blow.what: First basket brightening threshold at3447 (warm pixels >=10, prior3440-3446 max6); placement3448 retained. Later breaths not isolated by this detector.

A.x.catch.heard: Current sound_A contains the recorded catch design; overlap with blow/take/roar prevents a validated individual onset.
A.x.catch.what: First catch-core R>180,Y>140 pixel at3555, one pixel through3556, seven at3557; control3540-3554 zero. Placement3556 retained.

A.karst_flare.what: measured: whole-frame warm area 3 -> 253 px on 3815 (the rock floods), fastest 3822

A.desert_fire.what: measured: the first warm light on the sand, dim-warm area 5 -> 194 px on 3880, fastest 3885

historical_previous_record.on_frame: h1_A: strike1 3360 (the first frame's spark), strike2 3389 (sparks 3388-3390), strike3 3418 (3417-3419); the roar 3600 (the flames leap 3598-3608, L 38 -> 74, then the 12-frame lean-back); HER FIRE 3612-3660 (reveal_B 1372-1419): the fire's footprint shrinks ~2.7x as the camera pulls back -> the roar settles and recedes under it (-9 dB by 3660); karst 3815, desert 3880; watch-fire 1 4990-5040

offsets_not_moved.A.impact: DIRECTOR 01:25Z: the hit stays ON THE BAR (2640, bar 34 b1, A9's first frame); A-FIX moves the PICTURE's whiteout onto 2640 (measured before: plunge 2600, white 2606-2622). Effect + score hit stay; SOUND-C re-measures when A-FIX's frames land.

historical_previous_record.not_measurable: A14 3920-4240 (the beacon run: run_1..7) and A15, A19 are slates in the master; watch-fires 2-4 are too small in the wide frames to time
historical_previous_record.pending: EVERY RIDGE (reveal_a re-render, 3660-3800) not landed: the ridges' fires catching get measured then; A19+A20 = dawnrev_A (B's dusk reversed, 5840-6479): L rises 46 -> 83, alpenglow from ~6080; the fire and wind ambience get shaped on A-FIX's final pale frames
